name: Ohio Northern University
academic_ranking: Ohio Northern University is a private university in Ada, OH, comprising the Colleges of Arts & Sciences, Business Administration, Engineering, Pharmacy, and Law. It is known for strong professional and pre-professional programs (notably its highly regarded pharmacy and engineering programs) and reports a roughly 95% job and graduate-school placement rate for graduates.
financial_aid: 99.6% of students receive financial support, with roughly $59-72M awarded annually in scholarships and grants and average financial support in the ~$28,000-32,500 range (per onu.edu). Merit scholarships for 2026-27 first-year students: Presidential $28,000-31,000, Trustees $27,000-30,000, Deans $25,000-28,000, Faculty $22,000-24,500 (higher amounts in the College of Pharmacy). FAFSA required (school code 003089); apply by Dec. 1 for maximum consideration. As an NCAA Division III institution, ONU does not offer athletic scholarships; aid is need- and merit-based.
facilities_notes: Softball program competes as part of ONU Athletics in Ada, OH. Specific softball facility details were not enumerated on the softball program pages checked 2026-07.
program_reputation: NCAA Division III program competing in the Ohio Athletic Conference (OAC). The team pages reference an OAC Tournament and NCAA Tournament history section, indicating postseason participation.

Conference confirmed as Ohio Athletic Conference (OAC). As NCAA D3, no athletic scholarships (scholarship_count null).
